messages:
nora-ways: Quick QA — hitting 401s on streaming reconnects when the client uses a service account from a different project. Single-shot calls succeed, but after a reconnect the server rejects with aud mismatch. Anyone seen tokens with the wrong `aud` after a refresh?

sam-chen: Yep seen something similar. Is the client using the node SDK or the raw HTTP path?

nora-ways: node SDK (v1.8.2). Flow: streaming websocket -> connection drops -> client tries to reauth using cached token provider -> new token has `aud: \"projects/metrics-prod\"` but the endpoint expects `aud` like `https://inference.redwood/v1/projects/redwood-internal` so server returns 401.

alice-m: can you paste a debug log snippet? curious if the SDK is reusing the original token audience or the metadata server is returning a project-scoped aud.

nora-ways: sure — minimal log: 

```\n
[2131234567] connection lost, attempting reconnect
[2131234572] requesting token from tokenProvider (opts: reuse=true)
[2131234573] got token: {sub: \"svc-metrics@metrics-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com\", aud: \"projects/metrics-prod\", exp: 2131238167}
[2131234574] ws connect -> 401 unauthorized (aud mismatch)
```

jordan-l: Sounds like two potential issues: 1) metadata server / token provider returning project-scoped audience (common for in-project SA tokens), or 2) SDK caching the audience parameter and reusing it for subsequent requests to different tenant/route.

benp: We had a bug where the TokenProvider signature only accepted a single `aud` at construction time. If you create the client for one project then reuse the same provider across routes it reuses that audience. Fixed in master a few weeks ago (patch changes provider.getToken(aud?) to accept runtime aud).

sam-chen: can you try the quick repro? in node SDK branch `fix/reconnect-aud` I added a flag to force the token refresh to request `target_audience: resource://inference/redwood/v1/projects/<target>` — use `auth.setRuntimeAudience(...)` before reconnect.

nora-ways: tried `npm i @redwood/sdk@next` from your branch — reconnects now succeed in my dev env. PR link?

benp: PR: https://git.redd/r/inference/sdk/pulls/5123 — description: "TokenProvider: accept runtime audience for streaming reconnects". Includes unit tests and a small perf patch to avoid extra roundtrips.

alice-m: two small asks before we merge: 1) add an integration test that simulates cross-project reconnection, 2) add a log line when we request token with runtime aud so ops can debug similar incidents.

benp: yep will add both. Plan: land in canary channel today, rollout to shared-dev tomorrow during low traffic, then prod after 48h if no regressions.

deploy-bot: [canary] inference-sdk@v1.9.0-canary.1 deployed to canary cluster (sha: f1a2b3).

nora-ways: thanks — will keep an eye, and ping here if I see anything odd. :thumbsup:

sam-chen: fwiw, for long-term we should prefer impersonation or explicit OIDC token issuance with target_audience set to the route resource name when calling across projects. metadata-server tokens are convenient but tend to be project-scoped.

jordan-l: agreed. created ticket INF-2146 for follow-up (scope: docs + examples + upgrade guide).

nora-ways: great, closing this thread for now. If anyone hits the same thing DM me and I can share repro steps.
